analyst_view.overall: Gent (18th) and Red Star (15th) both have 4 points, so this goes a long way to deciding which of them stays in the race for the play-off places; Rik De Mil says the knockout round, not the top eight, is the aim and Gent must take points at home. Gent are without playmaker Laszlo Benes (foot, short term) as well as Tibe De Vlieger, Michel-Ange Balikwisha and Pieter Gerkens, none of whom the numbers know about. Red Star are without the suspended Aleksandar Katai (counted), top scorer Bamba Dieng and Timi Max Elsnik; Serbian previews today expect Marko Arnautovic to start up front after his illness, with Gudelj back from a ban in a back three and Krunic in midfield. Albert Riera wants a calm, controlled game and worries more about conceding than scoring. One Serbian report says an Italian refereeing crew is in charge; no referee is in the brief.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals (1.8 Gent, 0.8 Red Star). I lean lower, to about 2.4: Gent lose Benes, their main creator, on top of Balikwisha, Gerkens and De Vlieger, and Red Star are without top scorer Dieng and Elsnik, none of which is on the numbers' list. Arnautovic is now expected to start, so I trim the size from -9% to -7%; Riera's plan for a slow game still points lower, and Katai's ban is already counted.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, mostly Gent's, already nudged up for both sides' recent corner counts. Without Balikwisha and Benes Gent have less wide play and lose a set-piece taker, but a Red Star side that sits back in a back three tends to concede corners to the home side, so nothing clearly moves the total and I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards, with Gent's quiet recent record (-8%) and Red Star's higher count (+4%) already in. The stakes are real for both and Gudelj, a combative player, is back from a ban, but the referee is not confirmed and nothing the numbers miss clearly points either way, so I stay at 3.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.6 shots. I lean a little lower, to about 25.5, because Gent's injury list takes out several creators including Benes and Riera wants a calm game that gives Gent little; Arnautovic starting gives Red Star a focal point, so I trim the size from -5% to -4%. Gent's recent dip (-9%) and Red Star's busy shooting (+10%) are already counted.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 shots on target, already cut for Gent hitting the target far less than expected lately (-14%). With Benes, Balikwisha, Gerkens and De Vlieger out for Gent and Dieng missing for Red Star, I lean a little lower, trimmed slightly for Arnautovic's return: -5% gives about 8.3.
